title.en: An Act Extending the Scope of the Cancer Detection and Diagnostic Center of the Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital to Include also Cancer Treatment and Research, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The official title of the Cancer Detection and Diagnostic Center of the Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital shall be changed to "The Cancer Center, Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital", Department of Health.
The incumbent Head and the Staff of the existing Cancer Center of the Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital shall retain their respective positions and items in the Cancer Center.

Appointments to new positions in the Cancer Center shall be made in accordance with law and only according to merit and technical fitness as provided for by the qualifying rules and regulations of the Department of Health and the Civil Service Commission.

The powers, functions, and duties of all officers under the Department of Health on the cancer detection, diagnosis and therapy, together with all their equipment, supplies, records, files, personnel and balance of appropriations are transferred to the Cancer Center of the Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital.
Any income of the Cancer Center shall be retained by it in its revolving fund for expansion and improvement of its various services especially for the indigent cancer patients.

The Cancer Center of the Dr. Jose R. Reyes Memorial Hospital shall serve as the model for similar Cancer Centers to be established in five Medical Centers and Regional Training Hospitals throughout the Philippines, the number to be increased as the demand for service also increases.

The sum of five hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the Annual General Appropriations Act to be expended exclusively to carry out the purposes of this Act, including the construction of an office and the purchase of equipment.
All Acts, executive orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof, inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
